title: OsmBundleIndex
description: public/seed/osm-signals/index.json, version 2 (src/providers/osm/bundle.ts). A tile in covered and in files: read <tileId>.json. In covered only: known to hold no signals. Not in covered: the bundle does not speak for it; a file for it is a lower bound.

dataDate.description: The oldest of the extracts' dates, milliseconds since 1970; every bundled tile carries it as fetchedAt.

tileRows.title: TileRows
tileRows.description: Key: the row (the tile id's y). Value: inclusive runs of x, [x0, x1, x0, x1, ...], in order, not touching.
